mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_element_business_record (batch_id, data_type, data_subtype, row_index, project_id, display_name, record_json, extra_json, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{dataType}, #{dataSubtype}, #{rowIndex}, #{projectId}, #{displayName}, #{recordJson}, #{extraJson}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO data_element_business_record (batch_id, data_type, data_subtype, row_index, project_id, display_name, record_json, extra_json, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{item.batchId}, #{item.dataType}, #{item.dataSubtype}, #{item.rowIndex}, #{item.projectId}, #{item.displayName}, #{item.recordJson}, #{item.extraJson}, #{item.createdAt}, #{item.updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM data_element_business_record WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY row_index
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data_element_business_record WHERE data_subtype = #{subtype}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data_element_business_record WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}

SELECT r.data_subtype, COUNT(*) AS record_count, MAX(r.created_at) AS last_upload_time, (SELECT b.uploader FROM data_element_upload_batch b WHERE b.id = ( SELECT r2.batch_id FROM data_element_business_record r2 WHERE r2.data_subtype = r.data_subtype ORDER BY r2.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) ) AS last_uploader, (SELECT b.original_file_name FROM data_element_upload_batch b WHERE b.id = ( SELECT r3.batch_id FROM data_element_business_record r3 WHERE r3.data_subtype = r.data_subtype ORDER BY r3.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) ) AS last_file_name FROM data_element_business_record r GROUP BY r.data_subtype
SELECT * FROM data_element_business_record ORDER BY data_subtype, created_at
